# `silk/platform/windows/path`

<!-- Generated by silk doc-reference. Do not edit by hand. -->

Windows host paths represented in an explicit machine-wide path namespace.

## When to use

Use [`WindowsPath`](#WindowsPath) at compiler and process host boundaries. Drive paths map to `/C:/...`
and UNC paths to `/UNC/server/share/...`. These names are separate from a confined
`OsFileSystem` provider's `/`, which always denotes that provider's chosen root.

Import as `WindowsPath` with `import silk.platform.windows.path { WindowsPath }`.

Public declarations: 1.

<a id="WindowsPath"></a>

## `WindowsPath`

```silk
pub struct WindowsPath
```

Conversion between absolute Windows host names and machine-wide portable paths.

### Details

Case and canonical WTF-8 bytes are preserved. Converting a path does not access the host,
resolve links, or assert confinement. Relative paths and device namespaces are refused.


Converts an absolute Windows text path to `/C:/...` or `/UNC/server/share/...`.

#### Errors

- `FileError` with `InvalidPath` for relative paths, device namespaces, or non-normalized components.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the path cannot be allocated.

<a id="WindowsPath.impl.fromNativeBytes"></a>

### Associated function `fromNativeBytes`

```silk
pub effect fn fromNativeBytes(value: &[u8]) -> Path ! FileError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Converts canonical WTF-8 Windows host bytes to a machine-wide portable path.

#### Details

Accepts absolute drive and UNC names, including `\\?\C:\...` and `\\?\UNC\server\share\...`.
Normal names accept either separator. Extended names accept only backslashes. A trailing
separator is removed. Case, trailing component dots/spaces, and lone surrogates are preserved.
A drive root is represented by `/C:`, and a share root by `/UNC/server/share`.

#### Errors

- `FileError` with `InvalidPath` for malformed WTF-8, NUL, relative/device paths, empty
  components, `.` or `..`, or colons outside the drive prefix.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the path cannot be allocated.

<a id="WindowsPath.impl.toNativeBytes"></a>

### Associated function `toNativeBytes`

```silk
pub effect fn toNativeBytes(path: &Path) -> Bytes ! FileError | OutOfMemoryError ? &mut Allocator
```

Returns an extended Windows host name as canonical WTF-8, without a NUL terminator.

#### Details

`/C:/...` becomes `\\?\C:\...`; `/UNC/server/share/...` becomes `\\?\UNC\server\share\...`.
The extended prefix preserves trailing dots/spaces and avoids Win32's legacy path-length
normalization. Other arguments to a process must not be passed through this conversion.

#### Errors

- `FileError` with `InvalidPath` if the path lacks a volume, has invalid WTF-8, or contains
  a backslash or a colon outside its drive prefix.
- `OutOfMemoryError` if the host name cannot be allocated.
